# OwnFeed

> OwnFeed is an independent Chrome extension for YouTube that filters recommendations by user-selected topics and hides distracting layout elements.

OwnFeed is in development. Public extension downloads and a Chrome Web Store release are not available yet. The website demo is illustrative and does not access a visitor's YouTube account. Free layout controls and manual channel blocking need no account. AI topic filtering uses your own TypeSafe/Jev API key. OwnFeed is free; provider usage charges apply. No OwnFeed account or subscription is required.

## Product

- [OwnFeed homepage](https://ownfeed.tech/): Product overview, illustrative demo, modes, pricing, and frequently asked questions.
- [Product facts](https://ownfeed.tech/about.md): Plain Markdown description of features, availability, installation, account requirements, and data handling.
- [Release availability](https://ownfeed.tech/#installation): Public downloads and the Chrome Web Store release are not available yet.
- [Pricing](https://ownfeed.tech/#pricing): Free controls and TypeSafe BYOK topic filtering.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://ownfeed.tech/privacy): Browser storage, optional AI provider requests, and preview limitations.
- [Terms of Service](https://ownfeed.tech/terms): Preview status, availability, and planned billing.

## Source and setup

- [Source repository and local setup](https://github.com/alokdangre/FocusFeed#run-locally): The source repository retains its historical FocusFeed name; the product is called OwnFeed.
